방.x: My room is small but clean.
방.e: -방 = room for an activity: 노래방 (karaoke, 'song room'), PC방 (internet café).

양말.x: It was cold, so I put on thick socks.
양말.t: Socks and shoes use 신다, not 입다: 양말을 신어요.

밝다.x: This room is bright because the window is big.
밝다.t: Pronounced [박따], but 밝아요 [발가요]. 밝은 성격 = a cheerful personality.

횡단보도.ex: 길을 건널 때는 꼭 횡단보도로 건너세요.
횡단보도.x: Always use the crosswalk when you cross the street.

청소기.x: I cleaned my room with the vacuum this morning.
청소기.t: For 'to vacuum', say 청소기를 돌리다, literally 'to run the vacuum'.

목도리.ex: 엄마가 저에게 따뜻한 목도리를 만들어 주셨어요.
목도리.x: My mom made me a warm scarf.
목도리.t: 목도리 is a thick winter scarf; a thin fashion scarf is a 스카프. Both take 하다 or 두르다.

충분하다.m: to be enough, to be sufficient
충분하다.x: There's still plenty of time, so take it slow.

홍보.x: We're promoting the new product online.
홍보.e: Literally 'broad report' — spreading the word widely.
홍보.t: 홍보 is broader than 광고, which means a specific ad.

축제.x: A big festival is held at the university in the fall.

적어도.ex: 하루에 적어도 물을 여덟 잔 마시세요.
적어도.x: Drink at least eight glasses of water a day.
적어도.e: From 적다 'to be few' + -어도 'even if': even if it's few.

조리법.x: I found a kimchi stew recipe online.

공감하다.m: to empathize, to relate to; to agree
공감하다.x: I agree with that opinion too.
공감하다.t: It takes 에: N에 공감하다 'to relate to N'.

억지로.forms: 억지로 + verb: 억지로 먹다, 억지로 웃다, 억지로 시키다
억지로.m: by force, against one's will, reluctantly
억지로.x: I was full, but I forced myself to eat it all.
억지로.t: Pronounced [억찌로]; 억지 부리다 means 'to be unreasonable, insist stubbornly'.

무엇보다.x: Above all, health is the most important thing.

방침.x: The company announced a new operating policy.
방침.e: Literally 'direction needle', like a compass needle pointing the way.

직거래.m: direct trade (without a middleman); in-person deal
직거래.x: I bought apples directly from the farmer.
직거래.e: 직 'direct' plus 거래 'trade', literally 'going and coming'.
직거래.t: Pronounced [직꺼래]. On secondhand apps it means meeting in person rather than shipping.

생필품.ex: 마트에서 휴지와 비누 같은 생필품을 샀어요.
생필품.x: I bought daily necessities like toilet paper and soap at the supermarket.
생필품.e: Short for 생활필수품, 'goods necessary for living.'

직캠.m: fancam, focused video of one performer
직캠.ex: 무대 직캠 조회수가 벌써 백만이 넘었어요.
직캠.x: The fancam of the stage already has over a million views.
직캠.e: 직(접) 'directly, in person' + 캠 from English 'cam(corder)'.
직캠.t: Originally footage shot by fans; music shows now also upload official 개인 직캠 that follow each member.

합리화.x: Don't rationalize your own mistakes like that.

경전.ex: 불교 경전에는 부처의 가르침이 담겨 있어요.
경전.x: Buddhist scriptures contain the teachings of the Buddha.

속내.m: true feelings, inner thoughts, real intentions
속내.ex: 그 사람은 좀처럼 속내를 드러내지 않아요.
속내.x: That person rarely shows his true feelings.
속내.e: Built on 속 'inside', as in 속마음 'inner heart'.
속내.t: Pronounced [송내] — nasalization; pairs with 드러내다 'reveal' or 털어놓다 'open up'.

동요하다.m: to be shaken, to waver, to be unsettled
동요하다.x: The employees were greatly shaken by the sudden announcement.
동요하다.t: Not the same as 동요 (童謠) 'children's song'; context makes it clear.

주도적.ex: 그녀는 이번 프로젝트에서 주도적인 역할을 맡았어요.
주도적.x: She took a leading role in this project.

고래 싸움에 새우 등 터진다.forms: 고래 싸움에 새우 등 터진다고 · 고래 싸움에 새우 등 터지는 격이다
고래 싸움에 새우 등 터진다.m: when the powerful fight, the weak get hurt; caught in the crossfire
고래 싸움에 새우 등 터진다.ex: 고래 싸움에 새우 등 터진다고, 두 나라의 무역 전쟁으로 작은 회사들이 피해를 봤어요.
고래 싸움에 새우 등 터진다.x: When whales fight, the shrimp gets crushed—small companies suffered from the two countries' trade war.
고래 싸움에 새우 등 터진다.e: Two whales fight, and the little shrimp between them gets its back burst.
고래 싸움에 새우 등 터진다.t: Often used about small countries between big powers, or about office politics.

그 나물에 그 밥.forms: 그 나물에 그 밥이에요 · 그 나물에 그 밥이라서
그 나물에 그 밥.m: all the same; six of one, half a dozen of the other
그 나물에 그 밥.ex: 후보들이 다 그 나물에 그 밥이라서 뽑을 사람이 없어요.
그 나물에 그 밥.x: The candidates are all the same, so there's no one to vote for.
그 나물에 그 밥.e: Literally 'that rice with those greens' — the same old combination.

선을 긋다.forms: 선을 그어요 · 선을 그었어요 · 선을 그을 거예요 (ㅅ irregular)
선을 긋다.m: to draw the line; to set boundaries; to distance oneself from
선을 긋다.ex: 그는 그 소문과 자신은 관계가 없다고 선을 그었어요.
선을 긋다.x: He drew a clear line, saying he had nothing to do with the rumor.
선을 긋다.e: Literally 'to draw a line,' just like English.

경위.m: the details (of how something happened), the circumstances
경위.x: The police are investigating how the accident happened.
경위.e: Literally 'warp and weft' — the threads that make up the whole story.
rel: the whole story from start to finish

등기.ex: 집을 사면 바로 소유권 등기를 해야 해요.
등기.x: When you buy a house, you should register the ownership right away.
등기.e: Literally 'putting onto the record' — official registration.

인구 절벽.ex: 출산율이 낮아지면서 인구 절벽에 대한 걱정이 커지고 있어요.
인구 절벽.x: As the birth rate falls, worries about the demographic cliff are growing.
인구 절벽.e: Literally 'population cliff' — a sudden drop in the working-age population.

소급적용.ex: 개정된 법의 소급적용 여부를 두고 논란이 일고 있습니다.
소급적용.x: There is controversy over whether the amended law should apply retroactively.
소급적용.t: Pronounced [소급쩌굥] — tensing after ㅂ, then linking.

답변서.m: written answer, statement of defense (court filing)
답변서.ex: 피고는 한 달 안에 법원에 답변서를 제출해야 합니다.
답변서.x: The defendant must submit a written answer to the court within a month.
답변서.t: -서 marks an official document: 신청서 application, 계약서 contract, 답변서 answer.

원천징수.ex: 회사는 월급을 줄 때 소득세를 원천징수합니다.
원천징수.x: Companies withhold income tax when they pay salaries.
원천징수.e: Literally 'collecting at the source (the spring)' — tax taken before you get paid.
원천징수.t: Use 원천징수하다 for the employer withholding and 원천징수되다 for tax being withheld.

논리학.ex: 논리학을 공부하면 생각을 더 체계적으로 할 수 있습니다.
논리학.x: Studying logic helps you think more systematically.
논리학.t: Pronounced [놀리학] — ㄴ becomes ㄹ before ㄹ.

겸연쩍다.x: I felt sheepish at the praise, so I just smiled.
겸연쩍다.e: Sino 겸연 + native -쩍다 'feeling like'; the variant 계면쩍다 is also standard and common in speech.
겸연쩍다.t: Pronounced [겨면쩍따]; common pattern: 겸연쩍게 웃다 — to smile sheepishly.

개인정보유출.ex: 개인정보유출 사고로 많은 고객이 피해를 입었습니다.
개인정보유출.x: Many customers were harmed by the personal data leak.
개인정보유출.t: News usually writes it with spaces: 개인 정보 유출.

핵심기술.ex: 핵심기술이 해외로 유출되지 않도록 보호해야 합니다.
핵심기술.x: Core technologies must be protected so they don't leak overseas.
핵심기술.t: Pronounced [핵씸기술]; 핵심 alone is very common: 핵심 내용 'the main point.'

복제품.ex: 박물관 기념품 가게에서 유명한 그림의 복제품을 팔아요.
복제품.x: The museum gift shop sells reproductions of famous paintings.
복제품.t: Pronounced [복쩨품] — the ㅈ after ㄱ is tensed.

집현전.m: Jiphyeonjeon, Hall of Worthies (royal research institute)
집현전.ex: 세종대왕은 집현전 학자들과 함께 한글을 만들었어요.
집현전.x: King Sejong created Hangeul together with the scholars of the Jiphyeonjeon.
집현전.t: Pronounced [지편전] — ㅂ plus ㅎ becomes ㅍ.

정연하다.ex: 그의 주장은 논리가 정연해서 설득력이 있어요.
정연하다.x: His argument is logically well-organized, so it's persuasive.
정연하다.t: Common as 논리 정연하다 'logically coherent' and 질서 정연하다 'in perfect order'.

흡사하다.m: very similar, closely resembling, just like
흡사하다.ex: 두 사람의 목소리가 흡사해서 구별하기 어려워요.
흡사하다.x: Their voices are so similar that it's hard to tell them apart.
흡사하다.t: The adverb 흡사 means 'just like': 흡사 꿈을 꾸는 것 같았다.

공급과잉.x: Chip prices fell sharply because of oversupply.
공급과잉.t: Pronounced [공급꽈잉]; the opposite is 공급 부족 'shortage.'
